messages.subject: For Mitsuko Yokomoto | Sustainability, mining customers and global stakeholder execution
messages.body:
Dear Komatsu Corporate Communications Department,

Please place this executive introduction before Ms. Mitsuko Yokomoto, Director and Senior Executive Officer supervising Human Resources, Education, Safety & Health Care and Sustainability.

Komatsu's current growth plan links manufacturing technology, automation, decarbonisation, human capital and sustainability into one enterprise agenda. That integration closely matches the operating environment in which I currently work from the mining side.

I serve as Liaison Director, Social Responsibility Department at AGM Inc., part of Zijin Mining Group. My mandate combines government and regulatory relations, ESG and social performance, corporate affairs, strategic partnerships and executive advisory across a major mining operation. I also support stakeholder governance around industrial solar and battery infrastructure and carbon-accounting evidence work.

I would value a conversation about where this mining-operator perspective might support Komatsu's sustainability, stakeholder, social-performance or international growth priorities. My attached CV has been tailored specifically to Komatsu's current direction.

Kind regards,
Ragunauth Ramsaroop
Liaison Director, Social Responsibility Department | AGM Inc.
